units.source_text: 此时夕雾躲在暗处偷看。

en.t: At this moment, Yugiri was hiding in the shadows and secretly watching.

units.source_text: 若在平时，他这种行径要防别人讥评。

en.t: At any ordinary time, he would have had to fear being criticized for such behavior.

units.source_text: 但此时恋情正苦，顾不得许多了，只管站在那里揩眼泪。

en.t: But now his love was so painful that he could no longer care about such things, and he simply stood there wiping away his tears.

units.source_text: 乳母十分可怜他，便向太君商请，乘这傍晚众人往来杂沓之时，教两人在另一室内会面了。

en.t: His nurse took great pity on him, spoke with the grand lady, and, taking advantage of the busy coming and going at dusk, arranged for the two of them to meet in another room.

units.source_text: 两人一见之下，无限羞涩，心头乱跳，一句话也说不出来，只是相对而泣。

en.t: As soon as they saw each other, they were overcome with shyness, their hearts pounding wildly, and they could not say a single word, but only faced each other and wept.

units.source_text: 后来夕雾言道：“舅舅真狠心啊！

en.t: After a while, Yugiri said, "My uncle is truly cruel!

units.source_text: 我原想，他要带走你，就由他带走吧，让我死了这条心。

en.t: I had thought that if he meant to take you away, I should let him do it and give up this love of mine.

units.source_text: 但今后我若不见了你，相思必定更苦了！

en.t: But if I cannot see you from now on, my longing will surely become even more painful!

units.source_text: 回思从前见面机会较多之时，我们何不常常相聚呢？”

en.t: When I think back to the days when we had more chances to meet, why did we not spend more time together?"

units.source_text: 说时神情天真烂漫，非常可爱。

en.t: As he spoke, his expression was innocent and openhearted, and very endearing.

units.source_text: 云居雁答道：“我也这样想呢。”

en.t: Kumoi no Kari answered, "I have been thinking the same thing."

units.source_text: 夕雾接着问：“你想念我么？”

en.t: Yugiri then asked, "Do you miss me?"

units.source_text: 云居雁微微地点点头，竟是小孩模样。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari gave a faint little nod, looking just like a child.
